title: Baby Toddler fruit, vegetables, and meat

content.title: About
content.content: This blend of fruit, vegetables and meat is designed for babies and toddlers from 6 months to 3 years. It contains carefully selected soft fruits, cooked vegetables and tender meat, prepared without added salt, sugar or artificial flavours. The product provides a variety of tastes and essential nutrients needed for healthy growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fruits and vegetables are steam‑cooked to retain most of their vitamins and minerals.
The meat component is usually chicken or turkey, lean and easy to digest for a young stomach.
The blend is free from gluten and dairy, making it suitable for children with intolerances.
Each serving is sized for one meal and contains roughly 70–90 kcal, facilitating calorie control.
The product meets strict infant‑food safety standards in the EU and the US.

items.title: Rich in vitamins A and C
items.content: Vitamin A supports vision and immunity, while vitamin C aids iron absorption and protects cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of iron and zinc
items.content: Meat provides highly bioavailable iron and zinc, essential for blood formation and immune function.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Fiber from the fruit and vegetables promotes healthy bowel movements and helps develop a balanced gut microbiome.

items.title: Low in sodium
items.content: No added salt helps establish a healthy taste preference early in life.

items.title: Easily digestible protein
items.content: Lean meat supplies the amino acids needed for muscle and organ growth.

items.title: Allergy to food components
items.content: Some children may be allergic to the fruit, vegetable or meat. Introduce a small amount first and monitor for reactions.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Although the product is a puree, large lumps can form if not mixed properly. Always check consistency before serving.

items.title: Natural fruit sugars
items.content: Fruits contain natural fructose; families with a history of diabetes should consult a pediatrician.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the product as a smooth puree or a soft mash. You may thin it with breast milk, formula, or water to reach the desired consistency. For children over 12 months, small soft pieces of cooked vegetable or meat can be mixed in.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package in a cool, dry place. Once opened, store in the refrigerator at 0 °C–4 °C and use within 48 hours. Do not freeze. Discard if you notice off‑odors, discoloration or mold.
